entries.proposition: VARIANT 4 IN NORMAL OVARY: 9/13 (69%), a frequency similar to tumours. DATO. The Delta6-8 transcript is therefore not tumour-specific in this tissue.
entries.snippet: WWOX variant 4 expression was surprisingly detected in 9 out of 13 (69%) normal ovarian tissue samples, a frequency similar to that detected in the tumours.
entries.anchor: Results > WWOX variant 4 is expressed in normal ovary tissue, sentence 2

experimental_context.system: human tissue, epithelial ovarian tumours and contralateral normal ovaries
experimental_context.endpoint: WWOX variant 1 / variant 4 mRNA by RT-PCR

entries.proposition: VARIANT 4 LEVELS: normals 0-0.33, tumours 0-3.65 relative units, both declared unreliable. DATO.
entries.snippet: The relative WWOX variant 4 expression (WWOX/β-ACTIN) was low and appeared similar in the normal ovarian tissues (from 0 to 0.33) and in the ovarian tumours (from 0 to 3.65), although quantitation of such low expression is unreliable.
entries.anchor: Results > WWOX variant 4 is expressed in normal ovary tissue, sentence 3

experimental_context.system: human tissue, epithelial ovarian tumours and contralateral normal ovaries
experimental_context.endpoint: WWOX variant 1 / variant 4 mRNA by RT-PCR

entries.proposition: DISCUSSION DENOMINATORS: 60/69 below the normal median and 34/69 below the lowest normal. DATO as printed; here the denominator is 69, the Results used 71 for the same tumours.
entries.snippet: Tumours in our study showed 87% (60/69) variant 1 expression levels lower than the median expression level of the normal ovaries, and 49% (34/69) of the tumours exhibited less variant 1 expression than the lowest expressing normal ovary sample.
entries.anchor: Discussion, paragraph 4

experimental_context.system: human tissue, epithelial ovarian tumours and contralateral normal ovaries
experimental_context.endpoint: WWOX variant 1 / variant 4 mRNA by RT-PCR

entries.proposition: METHOD COMPARISON: competitive PCR gave 50% v4-positive tumours. DATO.
entries.snippet: we also detected a high frequency of variant 4 expression in ovarian tumours (50%) using a competitive, non-quantitative PCR similar to that used in the earlier studies.
entries.anchor: Discussion, paragraph 5

entries.proposition: FOUR AUTHOR HYPOTHESES for the variant-4 association (FRA16D disruption marker, splicing-fidelity marker, gain of function, dominant negative). IPOTESI, none tested.
entries.snippet: It could represent: i) a surrogate marker of cancer-associated disruption at FRA16D, ii) a surrogate marker of cancer-associated disruption of splicing fidelity, iii) an oncogenic, gain of function WWOX isoform, or iv) a dominant negative WWOX iso-form.
entries.anchor: Discussion, paragraph 6

entries.proposition: CITED, NOT MEASURED: isoform 4 nuclear, isoform 1 cytoplasmic with TNF-alpha translocation (refs 14, 15). No localisation experiment in this paper.
entries.snippet: While WWOX isoform 4 is located in the nucleus, WWOX isoform 1 is located normally in the cytoplasm, but translocates to the nucleus following TNF-α treatment (14,15).
entries.anchor: Discussion, paragraph 6

entries.proposition: CITED: short-form proteins detected only under proteasome blockade (Watanabe 2003, ref 22). Not tested here.
entries.snippet: Watanabe et al (22) could only detect alternate transcript expression if the proteasome was blocked.
entries.anchor: Introduction, paragraph 3

entries.proposition: AUTHORS AGAINST THEIR OWN DOMINANT-NEGATIVE MODEL, on the normal-ovary result. INFERENZA (theirs).
entries.snippet: This perhaps argues against a dominant negative hypothesis, and suggests that the variant may be an infrequently produced splice form, even in normal cells.
entries.anchor: Discussion, paragraph 7

entries.proposition: AUTHORS' LIMIT: variant-4 role speculative until translation is shown. DATO as the authors' own limitation; no protein for variant 4 was sought in tissue.
entries.snippet: The role of WWOX variant 4 is clearly speculative at this time and progress is reliant on the demonstration that it is actually translated.
entries.anchor: Discussion, paragraph 7

entries.proposition: SUMMARY UPGRADES 'may be' to 'is': 'a frequent and early event'. IPOTESI stated as conclusion - no early lesion, stage-1 subgroup analysis or precursor tissue is shown.
entries.snippet: suggesting that reduced WWOX variant 1 expression is a frequent and early event in ovarian tumourigenesis.
entries.anchor: Discussion, summary paragraph

entries.proposition: SURFACE DEFECT: the nomenclature footnote prints 'A6-' where Delta6-8 is meant (author-manuscript conversion). Quoted as printed, not corrected. Variant 1 = NM_016373, variant 4 = NM_130788.
entries.snippet: Genbank nomenclature refers to the WWOX full length transcript (Genbank NM_016373) as variant 1 and to the A6- transcript (Genbank NM_130788) as variant 4.
